content: Curator paraphrase: Chandelier long and short levels use a rolling22-period highest high minus3 times ATR22 and lowest low plus3 times ATR22. These levels may rise or fall with the rolling extrema and volatility. This supplement uses a closed price beyond the corresponding held-position level to request an owned exit at the next execution opportunity. It is not an intrabar protective stop or a broker order; M5 adaptation and trading context are laboratory scope choices.
